title: An exact Jordan signature in cumulative-count first-passage statistics
summary: For cumulative-count first-passage problems, the Laplace transform of the time $\mathcal T_N$ of the $N$th count is naturally expressed through powers of a one-count kernel. A Jordan defect of that kernel does not, however, automatically survive the complete sum over terminal phases. We give an exact three-state Markov-renewal example in which it does.
